result.explanation: Maintain job phases and resource ownership. A begin is atomic: it succeeds only when the identifier is unused and every requested resource is free. Prepare, commit, and abort enforce their phase rules; releasing resources is atomic with terminal transitions.
result.mapping: jobs maps IDs to phase and requested resources; held maps resources to active or prepared job IDs; done stores committed IDs.
result.assumptions: Event fields are valid as specified. Output object key ordering is not semantically significant; done is sorted lexicographically.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){let s=null;for(let e of input.events){let r=solve({config:input.config,state:s,event:e});s=r.state;let o=r.output;if(!o||typeof o.status!=="string"||!o.held||!Array.isArray(o.done))return false;let d=o.done.slice().sort();if(JSON.stringify(d)!==JSON.stringify(o.done))return false;for(let k in o.held)if(!input.config.resources.includes(k))return false}return true}
result.program: function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state||{j:{},h:{},d:[]},e=event,id=e.id,status="invalid";if(e.type==="begin"){let ok=!s.j[id]&&e.resources.every(r=>s.h[r]===undefined);if(ok){s.j[id]={p:"active",r:e.resources.slice()};for(let r of e.resources)s.h[r]=id;status="begun"}else status="blocked"}else{let j=s.j[id];if(e.type==="prepare"){if(j&&j.p==="active"){j.p="prepared";status="prepared"}}else if(e.type==="commit"){if(j&&j.p==="prepared"){for(let r of j.r)delete s.h[r];j.p="committed";s.d.push(id);status="committed"}}else if(e.type==="abort"){if(j&&(j.p==="active"||j.p==="prepared")){for(let r of j.r)delete s.h[r];j.p="aborted";status="aborted"}}}let held={};for(let r of config.resources)if(s.h[r]!==undefined)held[r]=s.h[r];return{state:s,output:{status:status,held:held,done:s.d.slice().sort()}}}
